answers.core: For a game engine that's trying to support two different programming languages, I just find it weird that Animation Tree State Machine Advance Expressions can only be written in GDScript. It just alienates people who only use C# (i.e. people from Unity, people with prior C# knowledge). If you're going to support two languages, might as well go all the way, right?
answers.workaround: Yes, workarounds are possible. I've been told that there are functions for GDScript scripts to interface with the C# scripts and vice versa. I could try to access my C# variables using those functions within the Advance Expressions.

title: Please allow us to write Animation Tree State Machine Advance Expressions in C#
